method: Read-only inspection of locally installed public AppKit SDK headers; no compilation, execution, network request, or text submission.

evidence.finding: NSSpellChecker exposes unified checking results and correctionForWordRange, which proposes one correction for an explicit word range.
NSTextView exposes automaticSpellingCorrectionEnabled and applies checking results inside an interactive text-view lifecycle.
The inspected local base SDK identifies itself as macosx27.0.

reasons: No inspected public API accepts one complete prose span and returns the final whole-span autocorrect result used by interactive NSTextView typing.
The direct correction API is word-range based; a caller-authored loop that applies results would be a new protocol, not Apple's interactive autocorrect protocol.
Interactive behavior can depend on language selection, global preferences, learned spellings, document tag, typing order, and user response state.
The frozen specialist protocol requires deterministic whole-span minimal correction and byte-exact preservation of protected spans.
allowed_reporting: Report an NSSpellChecker word-candidate or NSTextView observational result in a separately labelled slice with exact host, language, preferences, and invocation.
forbidden_reporting: Do not place Apple autocorrect in the direct full-span error-reduction or frontier-parity table unless a new version proves protocol equivalence.
future_probe: A separately approved lightweight AppKit harness may record observational results, but it must not be described as protocol-equivalent and was not compiled or run in this tranche.
